description.value: Terra Nova Liquor Store is a retail alcohol shop located in a strip-mall unit along Westminster Highway in Richmond's Terra Nova area. It serves the surrounding residential and cycling community near the Terra Nova Rural Park and the popular riverside cycling routes. Cyclists passing through the area may find it a convenient stop for beverages.
